summary: Explains the reasoning behind the security design of Mobile IPv6 route optimization, which lets a mobile device and a peer talk directly instead of through a home agent. It records the thinking from 2001 to 2002 so implementers understand the design choices and designers of mobility or multihoming systems can avoid common security pitfalls.

eli5.summary: When someone moves house, mail can go through their old address or straight to the new one. This memo explains how to make the shortcut safe, so nobody can trick the post office into sending your letters to the wrong place.

questions: why is mobile ipv6 route optimization designed this way
